findings.message: src/projects/ProjectsView.tsx:73 `listClock = useNow(level is projects|project|workflow, LISTS_POLL_MS)`: ProjectsView is not remounted per route (App.tsx:701) and useNow only calls setNow on its first 15 s tick. After the operator comes back to /projects, a project page or a feature page from a run page (where the clock was inactive), every RunRow age ('last activity N min ago', 'N d ago'), each live row's elapsed time, the Runs home LiveStatus and homeSections' 7-day Recent cutoff use a stale instant for up to 15 s. Ages are understated and read 'just now' for recent activity. The clock should be read again when the lists become active.
findings.requirement: every list row says what happened, when and for how long

findings.message: src/projects/lists.ts rowTime: every unfinished run, including paused, interrupted and awaiting-approval runs, gets `ms: now - created_at`, a duration that grows without bound. The candidate Runs home screenshot shows run-challenge-paused as '363h20m' and run-awaiting as '457h40m', although those runs stopped minutes after they started. PRD 4.1 says the time and duration come from last_activity_at while live, so this row misstates how long the run ran.
findings.requirement: every list row says what happened, when and for how long

findings.message: The served-activity override applies to NowBanner only (servedNow in src/projects/NowBanner.tsx). RunView still derives document.title, graph/Steps attention, the node pages' RunBar and node-next from the export. On lists-asking the banner says ui's question waits, but the launch_ui node page, the graph and the tab title show no question. On a controller-stopped run only the banner switches to 'interrupted'. This is recorded as a deviation and follows from the decision not to edit RunView.tsx, but the run page is internally inconsistent until RunView passes activity and the controller readings to deriveNow/deriveAttention.
findings.requirement: The run page and the lists use the backend's served `activity` so waiting questions, pane attention and a stopped controller are visible without opening a run.

findings.message: src/projects/ReviewDetail.tsx ReviewerStrip/ReviewerTime: a pending reviewer's first line reads 'general No verdict no verdict recorded yet · no verdict · launched 09:40:00' (candidate screenshot review-blocking-first). The badge, reviewer-status and reviewer-time each say 'no verdict'. It is correct but redundant. reviewer-time could drop its 'no verdict ·' prefix, since reviewer-status must keep its exact text.
findings.requirement: a pending or superseded reviewer shows 'no verdict' with its launch time and no ticking clock

findings.message: src/projects/node/ControllerSections.tsx IntegrateSummary calls integratedCommit(events, null), so the unit-tested fallback to the reviewed candidate_commit (panels.ts integratedCommit) never runs in the UI. If an integrate event does not name a 40-hex commit, the line omits the commit even though the review's candidate_commit is available. NodeDetail loads the review only for review and approval nodes.
findings.requirement: integrate names the fast-forwarded branch and commit and 'no push performed'
